records.title: Tofersen / SOD1: VALOR and original US accelerated approval
records.population: Adults with SOD1-ALS; VALOR randomized 108: 72 tofersen and 36 placebo. Faster-progression primary analysis: 60.
records.design: Phase 3 VALOR, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; week-28 assessment.

observations.endpoint: ALSFRS-R change from baseline, faster-progression subgroup
observations.result: The prespecified primary joint-rank test with multiple imputation did not meet the endpoint.

observations.endpoint: ALSFRS-R change from baseline, faster-progression subgroup; supportive analysis
observations.result: The adjusted mean difference and confidence interval describe the supportive ANCOVA analysis, not the joint-rank test.
Both decreased relative to placebo; these are biomarker outcomes, not direct functional recovery.
FDA approval for adults with SOD1-ALS was based on plasma NfL reduction, with clinical-benefit confirmation required.

negative_evidence: VALOR's prespecified primary clinical result was nonsignificant.
unknowns: This historical record does not synthesize all later evidence. See the separately dated VALOR_OLE_FOLLOWUP.md for the bounded final VALOR/OLE extraction.
caveats: Do not generalize SOD1-specific evidence to all ALS.
Original 2023 label lists serious neurologic risks; this is not a current prescribing guide.
Open-label follow-up does not replace the randomized primary analysis.

scope_exclusions.reason: Excluded from this original-trial/approval record. Selected final VALOR/OLE outcomes and limitations are now extracted separately in VALOR_OLE_FOLLOWUP.md, dated 2026-11-08; the historical primary result is unchanged.

records.title: Ulefnersen / FUS: sponsor-reported FUSION topline result
records.design: FUSION: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 1-3 trial; 72-week controlled period, then open-label extension.

observations.endpoint: Joint rank: death/permanent ventilation, rescue, and ALSFRS-R change
observations.result: Sponsor reported a favorable primary comparison with placebo on 2026-09-22.

statistic.analysis_method: Prespecified joint-rank analysis as described by sponsor

observations.timepoint: Not detailed in the selected topline report
observations.result: Sponsor reported a significant favorable change; no numerical effect extracted.

negative_evidence: No negative controlled efficacy finding was reported in this selected topline source; this is not evidence of absence.
unknowns: Detailed effect size, uncertainty, subgroup results, and full safety analysis were not supplied in this topline summary.
caveats: Sponsor report, not a peer-reviewed full trial report in this map.
Rescue permits early open-label treatment after prespecified progression.
A composite p-value does not quantify survival gain.
Do not extrapolate to non-FUS ALS.

records.title: QRL-201 / STMN2: early ANQUR interim signals
records.population: Sporadic and C9orf72-related ALS; 69 dosed, including 17 dose-escalation and 52 dose-range-finding participants.
records.design: Double-blind, placebo-controlled ANQUR. Sponsor called it Phase 1 in 2024 and Phase 1/2 in 2026; current registry protocol not verified.

observations.endpoint: Safety and tolerability of repeated doses, per 2024 sponsor design description
observations.timepoint: Current protocol assessment window not verified
observations.result: 2026 sponsor report described generally acceptable tolerability; it did not provide a complete adverse-event table.

observations.endpoint: Tissue STMN2 expression/mis-splicing and low-dose pNfH
observations.result: Sponsor reported target engagement versus natural-history tissue and reduced low-dose pNfH.

observations.timepoint: 24 weeks for the reported post-hoc subset
observations.result: Overall trend; significant result reported only after post-hoc exclusion of highest-baseline-NfL participants.

negative_evidence: No confirmatory primary clinical efficacy success is established by these selected interim data.
unknowns: Numerical effect sizes, confidence intervals, multiplicity handling, and subgroup denominators were not supplied in the selected release.
caveats: Sponsor-only interim analysis; post-hoc exclusions can create optimistic results.
Target engagement and neurofilament changes do not establish clinical benefit.
2024 endpoint hierarchy may have changed; verify registry amendments.

records.title: DNL343: negative HEALEY Regimen G randomized result
records.population: ALS; 249 randomized within Regimen G: 186 active, 63 placebo; 76 concurrent shared controls, yielding 139 pooled placebo and 325 analyzed participants.
records.design: Double-blind HEALEY platform trial at 74 US centers; 200 mg/day tested for 24 weeks.

observations.endpoint: Bayesian joint function/survival disease rate ratio (DRR)
observations.result: Primary endpoint was not met; posterior probability DRR < 1 was 0.37.

statistic.analysis_method: Bayesian shared-parameter model of function and survival

negative_evidence: No demonstrated slowing at the tested formulation, dose, duration, and population; secondary clinical outcomes did not show benefit.
unknowns: A null trial does not resolve every alternative dose, formulation, exposure, or biological subgroup.
caveats: Credible interval and posterior probability are not a frequentist confidence interval or p-value.
Shared controls are not additional active-arm randomizations.
Prior target-engagement evidence did not establish clinical efficacy.

records.title: Relyvrio / AMX0035: PHOENIX failure and distinct withdrawal events
records.population: PHOENIX: 664 adults with ALS, randomized 3:2 active versus placebo, alongside standard care.

observations.endpoint: Change in ALSFRS-R total score from baseline
observations.result: Sponsor reported primary and secondary endpoints were not met on 2024-03-08.

statistic.analysis_method: Primary endpoint analysis; exact test not specified in selected sponsor release
statistic.p_value_method: Not specified in selected sponsor release

observations.endpoint: Market-removal announcement and end of new-patient access
observations.result: Amylyx announced a voluntary withdrawal process in the US and Canada; this was not FDA's effective approval-withdrawal date.
US approval withdrawal took effect, following the sponsor's voluntary request based on PHOENIX.

negative_evidence: The larger confirmatory PHOENIX trial failed to establish its prespecified clinical benefit.
unknowns: This record does not reproduce all earlier CENTAUR analyses, PHOENIX methods, or evidence in other diseases.
caveats: Sponsor topline efficacy data and an official regulatory action are different source types.
Canada's exact legal cancellation date is not established here.
Regulatory withdrawal is not a biological endpoint.

records.title: UNC13A: TDP-43-associated cryptic-splicing mechanism
records.population: Human brain tissue, neuronal cell lines, and induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived motor neurons; not a treatment trial population.
records.design: Ma and colleagues, published online 2022-02-23: laboratory perturbation and human tissue analyses.

observations.endpoint: UNC13A cryptic exon inclusion and protein abundance
observations.result: Nuclear TDP-43 loss promoted UNC13A cryptic splicing and reduced protein expression; risk variants increased mis-splicing under TDP-43 dysfunction.

observations.endpoint: Potential therapeutic relevance of correcting mis-splicing
observations.result: Mechanistic evidence motivates testing restoration; it does not demonstrate benefit in people with ALS.

negative_evidence: This mechanistic study contains no randomized patient efficacy test.
unknowns: Whether, when, and how much restoring UNC13A changes clinical outcomes is not answered by this record.
caveats: The cryptic exon event is not conserved in mouse; model choice matters.
Genetic risk association is not deterministic patient prognosis.
No individual-level datasets or predictive model were accessed or created.
